hashSemantics: localPath = the canonical copy in this repo (.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md); skillPath = where the file lives upstream. computedHash = sha256 of the canonical SKILL.md as it exists in THIS repo (not the upstream original). fileHashes = sha256 of EVERY other file in the skill — scripts/ (code the agent runs), references/ (instructions the agent obeys) and agents/openai.yaml (Codex invocation policy). All reach the model with the user's rights, so all are pinned. variants = the same pair for an archived harness-specific build kept out of discovery under .agents/variants/<harness>/<name>. CI fails if any file changes, or if a new file appears, without the lock being updated deliberately. Kit modifications are expected and documented in `note`.

design-taste-frontend.note: Revision 2026-10-18: replaced wholesale with upstream tasteskill v2 (f624f37, skills/taste-skill). The kit's 2026-07 progressive-disclosure split of the v1 monolith is dropped — upstream v2 is already a lean SKILL.md plus on-demand references/, library/ JSON, scripts/ and assets/. Reviewed in full: scripts/ are zero-dependency Node — draw.mjs deals directions from library/ and keeps a 24-entry history in ~/.taste-skill/history.json (TASTE_SKILL_HISTORY overrides); lint.mjs scans source; inspect.mjs serves a local file from a throwaway 127.0.0.1 server with a path-traversal guard and drives headless Chrome over CDP with a temp --user-data-dir; assets.mjs needs network and no keys — searches Openverse, Wikimedia Commons, Art Institute of Chicago, the Met, Internet Archive and NASA, downloads into the project with a credits.json and a licence filter. No instructions directed at the agent beyond the design workflow, no secret access. Kit modifications: disable-model-invocation: true and an explicit-invoke tail in the description — a from-scratch build is a deliberate call; the default UI entry point is `impeccable`.

impeccable.note: Canonical copy is the single portable build of impeccable 4.6.0 (engine 0.1.15) shared by Claude Code, Codex and Cursor through .agents/skills; harnesses read it via relative adapters. 4.x ships a compiled engine instead of the 3.x .mjs scripts: scripts/bin/darwin-arm64/impeccable is byte-identical to the official release asset (sha256 matches github.com/pbakaus/impeccable/releases/download/engine-v0.1.15/impeccable-darwin-arm64.sha256); other platforms are fetched by the scripts/impeccable launcher, which refuses an unverified download. The 0.5.1 harness-specific builds (3.2.1) are archived out of discovery under .agents/variants/{claude,cursor}/impeccable; their trees equal legacy-install-hashes.json so the installer can recognise and back up pristine legacy installs. Revision 2026-07: the Cursor build was previously unpinned — 66 executables shipping to Cursor users with no integrity check.
